Tables in the `jira` schema, populated by daily sync pipelines from two Jira
projects on `jtickets.atlassian.net`. Each pipeline writes a full snapshot of
its project to a new `date=` partition, so filter to one `date` before
counting.

## PSOM

The PSOM Jira Service Management project holds partner support tickets.

Each day at ~06:00 ET, the `psom-sync` Lambda fetches a full snapshot of all
tickets from the PSOM project and writes it as three Parquet partitions in S3:
one for tickets, one for their SLA clocks, and one for their comments. A single
Glue crawler then updates all three Athena tables. Join them on `key` and
`date`. Before 2026-09-29 the snapshot ran weekly, on Mondays.

::: {#psom-tables}
:::

## EDCPPTP

The EDCP - Partner Transition Project (EDCPPTP) board tracks partners as they
onboard or transition to CanadaLogin. Epics are departments and agencies, and
Applications under them are the partner services.

Each day at ~06:15 ET, the `edcpptp-sync` Lambda fetches a full snapshot of all
issues from the EDCPPTP project and writes it as three Parquet partitions in S3:
one for issues, one for their comments, and one for the Jira field catalog. The
Lambda registers each partition in Glue itself, with no crawler. Join the issue
and comment tables on `key` and `date`. Snapshots start on 2026-11-24.

The Lambda fetches only the fields on a reviewed allow-list, and never fetches
fields that identify individual public servants. Application custom fields
are stored as JSON in one column. See
[`edcpptp`](jira/edcpptp.qmd#custom-fields) for the list.

::: {#edcpptp-tables}
:::
